resources.string: Immersive 3D: re-renders every sound at a fixed spot in the room (recommended)
Light: in-place EQ, zero added delay (for video lip-sync)
Lock sound to the room (not to the phone)
Light mode: apply to all apps (global)
Pause camera when screen is off

Immersive 3D captures the player's audio, mutes the original and plays a head-tracked binaural version, so every instrument and effect keeps its own place in the room. When Android asks, choose "Entire screen": only audio is used, nothing is recorded or stored.

For best results turn OFF Dolby Atmos / spatial audio / 3D effects in your phone's sound settings while Immersive 3D is on, so the sound isn't virtualised twice.

Start tracking before pressing play (or pause/resume once) so the player's audio session is detected.
